title: Supply-chain hygiene: refresh identity & crypto deps and mitigate interoperability bugs
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Background: A recent dependency scan flagged multiple moderate-to-high CVEs across our identity stack (OpenSSL transitive issues, outdated JWT parsing libs, and an unmaintained SAML adapter). We also observed increased downstream customer support noise: intermittent SSO failures, token validation edge cases for atypical OAuth token shapes, and sporadic native build breakage when packaging private deployments. Goal: perform a controlled, auditable refresh of identity/crypto dependencies across the auth-service, identity-proxy, and on-prem installer while fixing compatibility regressions and adding detection/rollback primitives. This ticket coordinates the cross-repo work: inventory, upgrade path, small compatibility shims, CI gating, canary rollout, and security review.
comments: 2025-02-10 - Aisha Patel: Initial triage - compiled inventory of identity-related deps across codebase. Affected components: auth-service (Go), identity-proxy (Node), console-backend (Python), on-prem install artifacts. Candidate upgrades: OpenSSL 1.1.1 -> 3.0.x, jose/jwt libs -> maintained forks, python-saml -> actively maintained fork or replace with saml2-client. Noted some downstream integrations expect legacy SAML NameID formats.

2025-02-12 - Marco Chen: Ran dependency upgrade sandbox for auth-service. OpenSSL 3.0 build succeeds but token parsing tests fail in 2 of 14 suites due to stricter PEM parsing and a legacy cert chain use in our test fixtures. Added failing test cases to a temporary branch ENG-26101/fix-pem-handling.

2025-02-17 - Security team (Lina Morales): Performed CVE impact assessment. Two of the flagged CVEs are exploitable in our hosted environment (CVE-2024-XXXX and CVE-2024-YYYY). Recommended priority upgrade, but require staged rollout because of binary compatibility risks for on-prem customers. Requested security_review_required and audit log of changes.

2025-02-21 - Marco Chen: Identity-proxy (Node) upgrade to jwt-lib@^3.2.0 merged into experimental branch. Observed token revocation logic regressed in dev due to changes in default clock tolerance behavior. Implemented explicit clockTolerance config and added unit tests covering boundary cases (skewed tokens).

2025-02-26 - QA (Olivia Park): Integration test run across self-hosted matrix: Ubuntu 20.04, Rocky 9, and Alpine edge. Found a packaging failure on Alpine due to OpenSSL deprecation of certain legacy APIs. Created lightweight shim that falls back to bundled compatibility layer for alpine builds pending distro upgrade guidance.

2025-03-01 - Marco Chen: Opened PRs: auth-service#487 (OpenSSL 3.0, PEM fix), identity-proxy#219 (jwt lib upgrade + explicit clock tolerance), console-backend#162 (saml adapter swap & extra validation). Running staged CI that includes new acceptance tests for SAML responses with altered NameID formats.

2025-03-03 - Product (Sofia Alvarez): Noted potential customer impact for some on-prem customers with older distro stacks. Recommend 2-week opt-in canary for Dedicated and a coordinated upgrade playbook for private deploys.
